content: Vercel Hobby is free forever but restricted to non-commercial personal projects and has a hard 300s function timeout; Vercel Pro is /seat/mo with  included usage credit, 1TB bandwidth, and required once a project has any revenue or client-facing commercial use. For a solo-builder MVP with no revenue in v1, Hobby may be technically usable at first, but Pro (/mo) fits the -100/mo budget comfortably and removes ambiguity.
